metadata.title: Tensor valuations on Sobolev spaces
metadata.abstract: A complete classification is established for continuous, SL($n$) contravariant, and translation invariant tensor valuations defined on the Sobolev space $W^{1,p}(\mathbb R^n)$. When these valuations are further assumed to be homogeneous, the classification reveals that they are precisely the Fisher information tensors, which constitute a higher-order generalization of the Fisher information matrix.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: Sobolev 空间上的张量赋值分类
analysis.workSummary: 完整分类 W^{1,p}(R^n) 上连续、SL(n) 逆变且平移不变的张量赋值；加入相应齐次性后，得到 Fisher 信息张量，即 Fisher 信息矩阵的高阶推广。
analysis.breakthrough: 以赋值与协变性质刻画高阶 Fisher 信息对象。
analysis.limitations: 分类依赖连续性、逆变性、平移不变性及相应参数条件，不能推广为任意张量泛函的分类。
